Privacy Policy

Applies to pc.am, non-custodial PCoin wallets and miners, and optional PCoin web services. Last updated 18 November 2026.

1. Non-custodial wallets and miners

PCoin Wallet (Android am.pc.pcoinwallet, Windows PCoinWallet.exe) and the PCoin miners (Windows tray miner, Linux Core node, Android miner APK am.pc.pcoinminer) are strictly non-custodial programs that run on your own device. For the standalone Google Play app policy, see also PCoin Wallet ? Privacy Policy.

  • Keys stay on your device: Your private keys, 12-word or 24-word recovery phrase, local transaction history, and address book live only in local storage on your device (protected by Android Keystore on Android). None of this data is ever transmitted to us.
  • No tracking or analytics in apps: The mobile and desktop apps include no advertising SDKs, no third-party analytics, no crash-reporting trackers, and no user accounts.
  • Camera permission (Android Wallet): Used exclusively on-device when you tap Scan to read a payment QR code. Camera frames are never stored or sent anywhere.

2. Public blockchain & peer-to-peer network

PCoin is an open peer-to-peer blockchain. When you run a full node (including inside the Android or Windows apps) or connect to a Stratum mining pool (pool.pc.am:3333 or pool2.pc.am:3333), network peers and pool servers necessarily observe your connecting IP address, payout address, and submitted shares or transactions. Confirmed transactions and addresses on the PCoin blockchain are public forever by design.

3. Website (pc.am) & optional web accounts

pc.am and docs.pc.am serve static documentation behind Cloudflare, which processes standard HTTP request metadata (IP address, user-agent) for DDoS protection and aggregate, cookie-free Cloudflare Web Analytics. The Telegram/browser utility at pc.am/app queries public chain and index endpoints without holding keys.

If you choose to register an optional account on market.pc.am (shared with exchange.pc.am and wrapdesk.pc.am), we store only what is required to operate your account: your email address, password hash, two-factor authentication secret (when enabled), and your deposits, orders, wraps, and withdrawal addresses/transactions. We never sell personal data to third parties.

4. Data deletion & contact

Instructions for erasing local wallet data or requesting removal of an optional market.pc.am / exchange.pc.am web account are published at pc.am/delete-data. Questions can be sent to pcoin@pc.am (or pcoinpcn@gmail.com for Google Play inquiries).
